name: Security Layer
description: Defines how the system identifies, authorizes and protects: authentication configuration, roles, permissions, secure resources and their operations, access conditions and field-level controls, declarative policies and rules, data classification and rate limits, together with goal-oriented security concepts such as actors, objectives, delegations, threats, countermeasures and accountability (NIST SP 800-53 controls with STS-ml and XACML-style policy modelling). Code that checks identity or enforces permissions is evidence for elements here.
